## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `spend_limit`. One of `spend_limit`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | slim_… |
| `data.customer` | `string` | cus_… |
| `data.scope` | `string` | The spend limit's scope. One of `customer`, `subscription`, `property`. |
| `data.subscription` | `string` | sub_…, for subscription scope. |
| `data.property_key` | `string` | The usage property, for property scope. |
| `data.property_value` | `string` | The property value. Null: each value gets the amount; a row with a value overrides it. |
| `data.meters` | `array of string` | Meter keys. Null: all meters. |
| `data.interval` | `string` | day, week (ISO, from Monday) and month are calendar intervals in the business's time zone. period is the term of the subscription that bills the usage. One of `day`, `week`, `month`, `period`. |
| `data.amount_minor` | `integer` | The limit, in minor units of `currency`. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `data.mode` | `string` | The spend limit's mode. One of `hard`, `soft`. |
| `data.set_by` | `string` | The spend limit's set by. One of `operator`, `customer`. |
| `data.active` | `boolean` | True if the spend limit is active. |
| `data.effective_amount_minor` | `integer` | The amount that applies. A customer-scope hard limit you set is raised by a reached limit tier, unless you changed the limit after the tier was reached. Else amount_minor. |
| `data.spent_minor` | `integer` | Spend in the current interval. Null for a property limit with no property_value: each value has its own spend. |
| `data.reached` | `boolean` | spent_minor is at or above effective_amount_minor. |
| `data.resets_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. When the current interval ends. |
| `data.editable` | `boolean` | Portal only: the buyer set it, so the buyer can change it. |
| `data.created_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |
| `data.updated_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The customer's spend limits. |
| `404` | No such customer. |

